==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Prophecies]]
**[[Abaddon's Cursed]] ([[Perdition Rock]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Related skills==
*{{skill icon|Iron Mist}}
*{{skill icon |Glyph of Swiftness}}
*{{skill icon |Time Ward}} ([[elite]])

== Notes==
* The recharge reduction stacks with [[Fast Casting]] for Mesmer spells.
*This skill has both regular upkeep cost and overcast "upkeep". The overcast rate is three points of overcast per second.
**Assuming this is the only overcast skill used, and that it is recast every time it recharges, the enchantment must be dismissed around 2 seconds after casting it to avoid building overcast.
*Overcast caused by this spell will not be negated with [[Glyph of Energy]].

==Trivia==
*This skill uses the same icon as the ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' [[gw2:Weaver|Weaver]] skill [[gw2:Primordial Stance|Primordial Stance]].
*This is one of only two Elementalist skills with an upkeep cost (the other being [[Soul Ignition]]), and the only maintained skill with a continuous overcast [[Resource cost|additional resource cost]]. 
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
